Task: Write one test that fails on the change and passes on the base. The test asserts the correct behaviour and fails because the change breaks it. It does not attack anything. Leave content empty to name one test that already exists.

Reply with JSON only.

The JSON is one JSON object. It has path (string), content (string) and name (string). Do not add a command: Proven builds the command that runs the test.

Example:
{"path":"pkg/file_test.go","content":"package pkg\n\nimport \"testing\"\n\nfunc TestExample(t *testing.T) {\n\tif Got() != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatal(Got())\n\t}\n}\n","name":"TestExample"}
